title: ReSeg: Retraining-free segmentation of abdominal organs via generalizable semantic representation learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Abdominal organ segmentation is essential in modern medical applications. While existing deep learning approaches demonstrate promising performance, their heavy reliance on large-scale image data raises concerns over generalization capability and privacy risks. This motivates the development of generalizable segmentation training paradigms based on domain-randomized image synthesis, facilitating generalization across unseen real image domains. However, existing paradigms either suffer from limited segmentation performance when applied to abdominal organs, or require dataset-specific finetuning. To address these limitations, we propose ReSeg, a novel two-stage retraining-free framework for domain-agnostic zero-shot abdominal organ segmentation. translated_title: ReSeg：通过可泛化语义表征学习实现无需重新训练的腹部器官分割
translated_abstract: 腹部器官分割在现代医学应用中至关重要。尽管现有的深度学习方法展现出良好的性能，但它们对大规模图像数据的严重依赖引发了关于泛化能力和隐私风险的担忧。这促使了基于域随机化图像合成的可泛化分割训练范式的发展，从而实现对未见过的真实图像域的泛化。然而，现有范式要么在应用于腹部器官时分割性能有限，要么需要针对特定数据集进行微调。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了ReSeg，这是一种新颖的两阶段、无需重新训练的框架，用于域无关的零样本腹部器官分割。在第一阶段，我们的器官无关合成数据驱动预训练方法，利用由专用数据引擎生成的语义和视觉上多样化的合成图像来优化可泛化表征（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了无需重新训练的两阶段框架ReSeg，利用器官无关的多样化合成数据进行可泛化语义表征学习，实现了域无关的零样本腹部器官分割，摆脱了对大规模真实图像数据和特定数据集微调的依赖。
en_tdlr: ReSeg is a two-stage retraining-free framework that leverages organ-agnostic synthetic data for generalizable semantic representation learning, enabling domain-agnostic zero-shot abdominal organ segmentation without relying on large-scale real images or dataset-specific finetuning.
